storm-king-art-center.why_flagged: Bloomberg Philanthropies is listed in Storm King's 2025 donor list in the Ambassador tier ($100,000+).

casa-frança-brasil-rio-de-janeiro.why_flagged: The former Casa França-Brasil now operates as Casa Brasil, with Petrobras as sponsor through its Novos Eixos call (Ícones da Cultura Brasileira line). The rename date is not confirmed.

state-tretyakov-gallery-moscow.watch: Director Zelfira Tregulova removed 9 Feb 2023 after a Ministry-forwarded complaint of 'destructive ideology'. The Ministry cancelled the 9th Moscow Biennale on 3 Nov 2022.

national-portrait-gallery-london.why_flagged: The Sackler Trust withdrew a planned £1M gift in March 2019 after Nan Goldin threatened a boycott. BP sponsorship of the portrait award ended in December 2022.

national-theatre-london.why_flagged: Announced in October 2019 that Shell's corporate membership would end in 2020. Named in the May 2026 letter urging theatres to cut ties with Bloomberg Philanthropies.

frye-art-museum.watch: The museum laid off 21 part-time and on-call workers on 10 April 2020. The Art Workers Union picketed that day, saying two of its bargaining-committee members were targeted, and petitioned for reinstatement. Director Joseph Rosa said union membership had no bearing on the lay-offs.

seattle-art-museum-seattle.funding: Expenses $44.4M (FY2025 Form 990). Institutional partners on the corporate-support page archived 26 May 2026 include Amazon, Alaska Airlines and Bloomberg Philanthropies.
seattle-art-museum-seattle.why_flagged: Boeing and Honeywell, both US defence contractors, are named as institutional partners on the museum's corporate-support page.
seattle-art-museum-seattle.watch: In January 2022 Decolonize SAM, an anonymous staff collective, called for a boycott over stone bollards installed in June 2021 and private guards hired to keep unhoused people off the museum grounds. The museum said the guards were hired after violent incidents around the building.

american-museum-of-natural-history-new-y.watch: Koch left the board in 2016. Mercer's term expired in December 2019. The museum stopped taking Sackler gifts in May 2019.

smithsonian-air-and-space-washington.why_flagged: Boeing names the Milestones of Flight Hall, Northrop Grumman names the planetarium and Lockheed Martin names the IMAX theater.
smithsonian-air-and-space-washington.watch: Boeing names the Milestones of Flight Hall, Northrop Grumman names the planetarium and Lockheed Martin names the IMAX theater. The Koch hall is at the Natural History Museum.

art-gallery-of-south-australia-adelaide.why_flagged: BHP is Presenting Partner of the gallery's Tarnanthi festival. Samarco, a joint venture between BHP and Vale, is paying compensation for the 2015 dam collapse near Mariana, Brazil.

national-museum-of-american-history-smit.watch: In July 2025 the museum removed a reference to Trump's two impeachments from its presidency exhibit. In August 2025 the White House ordered a review of its exhibits.

wiels-contemporary-art-centre.watch: Fundação Calouste Gulbenkian supported the Ana Jotta show (Sept 2024 to Jan 2025); it sold its oil company Partex in November 2019. Phillips drew a March 2022 boycott call. Loterie Nationale runs Scooore betting.

national-gallery-london.why_flagged: Shell ended its 12-year partnership with the National Gallery in 2018, saying it would focus on Stem programmes. Activists had staged protests at the gallery against the sponsorship.

jewish-museum-and-tolerance-center-mosco.why_flagged: Viktor Vekselberg, Leonard Blavatnik, Roman Abramovich, Gennady Timchenko and Mikhail Gutseriev co-founded the museum's endowment fund in February 2014, Kommersant reported.
jewish-museum-and-tolerance-center-mosco.watch: Kommersant reported in 2014 that no manager had been named for the museum's endowment. Vekselberg also sits on the Tretyakov Gallery's board of trustees.
